concepts.title: เริ่มต้น TypeScript 7: ติดตั้ง tsc, tsconfig.json แบบ strict และ Type Stripping ของ Node.js
concepts.covers: What TypeScript is (JS + static types, types are erased at runtime, tsc = type check + emit JS). Project ~/projects/ts-lab: npm init -y, set "type": "module", npm install -D --save-exact typescript@7.0.2 @types/node@24.19.2, npx tsc -v -> 'Version 7.0.2'. Show the exact strict tsconfig.json used by the whole topic (see notes.tsconfig). Example src/app.ts with a deliberate bug (passing a string where a number is expected) -> show the REAL tsc error output (error TS2345 ... with file:line:col and 'Found 1 error'), fix it, npx tsc, node dist/app.js. Then run the same file directly with `node src/app.ts` (Type Stripping, unflagged since Node 22.18.0 / 23.6.0, so Node 24 and 26 support it) and prove that Node does NOT type-check (a type error still runs). npm scripts build/typecheck/dev/start. Mention TS 7 is the Go-native compiler; 6.0.3 is the last JS-based release, and tools that call the TypeScript API may still need 6.x.
concepts.env: wsl (Ubuntu 24.04, Node LTS via nvm, local typescript@7.0.2)

concepts.title: Primitive Types, Type Inference, Arrays และ Tuples
concepts.covers: string/number/boolean/bigint/null/undefined, annotations vs inference (hover in VS Code), when to annotate (function params, empty arrays, public APIs), const vs let literal widening, number[] vs Array<number>, readonly arrays, tuples [string, number] and named tuples, noUncheckedIndexedAccess making arr[i] be T | undefined. Example src/c02-basics.ts: a small Thai-baht shopping cart summary (items as tuples [name, price, qty]) with real output, plus tsc errors TS2322 and TS18048 ('possibly undefined') shown verbatim.

concepts.title: Object Types: type alias กับ interface, Optional (?) และ readonly
concepts.covers: Object type literals, type alias vs interface (extends, declaration merging, when to pick which; team convention: type for unions/data, interface for object contracts that are implemented/extended), optional properties with exactOptionalPropertyTypes (difference between missing and undefined), readonly properties and Readonly<T>, excess property checks, index signatures vs Record. Example src/c03-objects.ts: User and Task models (somchai, somsri) printed as a table, with real TS2353 (excess property) and TS2540 (readonly) errors.

concepts.title: Functions แบบมี Type: Parameter, Return Type, Optional/Default, Rest และ Overloads
concepts.covers: Parameter and return annotations, void, optional and default parameters, rest parameters, function type expressions and callbacks (typing a callback for Array.filter/map), arrow functions, function overloads (formatPrice(number) / formatPrice(number[]) with one implementation), noImplicitReturns. Example src/c04-functions.ts: price/discount helpers with overloads and real output; show TS2554 (wrong argument count) and TS7030 (not all code paths return a value) errors.

concepts.title: Union, Intersection, Literal Types และการใช้ Union แทน enum
concepts.covers: Union (A | B), intersection (A & B), string/number literal types, as const objects and arrays, deriving a union from a const array (typeof ARR[number]), why the topic prefers union literals over enum: enum is not erasable so erasableSyntaxOnly rejects it (show the real TS1294 error) and node type stripping cannot run it. Example src/c05-unions.ts: Priority = 'low' | 'medium' | 'high', Status = 'todo' | 'doing' | 'done', a PRIORITIES const array, and a function that sorts tasks by priority with real output.

concepts.title: Narrowing, Discriminated Unions, Exhaustive Check และ any / unknown / never
concepts.covers: Narrowing with typeof, truthiness, ===, in, instanceof, Array.isArray, user-defined type guards (x is T); discriminated unions with a 'kind' field (Command = add | list | done | remove); exhaustive switch with a never assertNever helper and the REAL error when a new case is added but not handled; any vs unknown vs never (JSON.parse returns any - assign to unknown and narrow). Example src/c06-narrowing.ts: a mini command parser for argv-like arrays returning Command | error, with real output for valid and invalid input.

concepts.title: Classes, Access Modifiers และการ implements Interface
concepts.covers: Class fields with types, constructor, public/private/protected/readonly, JS #private fields vs TS private (runtime vs compile-time privacy), implements an interface, abstract classes, override keyword with noImplicitOverride, getters. IMPORTANT: parameter properties (constructor(private x: T)) are NOT erasable, so with erasableSyntaxOnly declare fields explicitly; show the real TS1294 error once. Example src/c07-classes.ts: BankAccount / SavingsAccount with deposit/withdraw that throws on insufficient funds, real output plus TS2341 (private access) error.

concepts.title: Generics และ Constraints
concepts.covers: Why generics (identity, first<T>(arr: T[]): T | undefined), type argument inference, multiple type params, constraints with extends (T extends { id: string }), keyof constraints (getProp<T, K extends keyof T>), default type params, generic interfaces and classes. Example src/c08-generics.ts: an InMemoryRepository<T extends Entity> with findAll/findById/save/remove used for both Task and User, plus a Result<T, E> type; real output and a real TS2344/TS2345 constraint error.

concepts.title: Modules, Declaration Files (.d.ts), @types และการย้าย JavaScript มาเป็น TypeScript
concepts.covers: ES modules in TS with module nodenext: import paths use .ts extension + rewriteRelativeImportExtensions (consistent with Part 1), import type and verbatimModuleSyntax, node: built-ins typed by @types/node, what a .d.ts is, writing a .d.ts for a local legacy JS file (legacy/slugify.js + slugify.d.ts), TS7016 'Could not find a declaration file' error, @types packages, lib 'dom' for browser code (type-check only demo of document.querySelector returning Element | null). Migration steps: allowJs, // @ts-check + JSDoc, checkJs, rename file by file. Example: src/c09/main.ts importing src/c09/math.ts and the legacy JS module; real output.

concepts.title: keyof, typeof, Indexed Access และ Utility Types (Partial, Required, Pick, Omit, Record, ReturnType, Awaited)
concepts.covers: keyof T, typeof value in type position, T['key'] and T[number], satisfies operator, utility types Partial, Required, Readonly, Pick, Omit, Record, ReturnType, Parameters, Awaited, NonNullable. Example src/c10-utility.ts: NewTask = Omit<Task, 'id' | 'createdAt'>, TaskPatch = Partial<Pick<Task, 'title' | 'priority' | 'status'>>, countByStatus returning Record<Status, number>, Awaited<ReturnType<typeof loadTasks>>; real output and real errors.

concepts.title: Mapped Types, Conditional Types และ Template Literal Types
concepts.covers: Mapped types ({ [K in keyof T]: ... }), modifiers (-readonly, ?), key remapping with as, conditional types (T extends U ? X : Y), infer, distributive behaviour, template literal types (`task:${Status}` event names, Capitalize), building a type-safe event emitter map (on<'task:done'>). Example src/c11-typelevel.ts: a typed EventBus whose event names are generated from Status, plus a DeepReadonly and a Getters<T> mapped type; real output and the real error when emitting a wrong event name or payload.

concepts.title: Async, fetch และ Runtime Validation ด้วย zod พร้อม Testing ด้วย node:test
concepts.covers: Promise<T>, async/await return types, typing fetch responses (res.json() is unknown-ish/any - never trust it), zod 4.6.7 schemas (z.object, z.enum, z.email(), z.infer, safeParse, z.prettifyError) at boundaries, a Result type for errors. Example: src/c12/users.ts fetches from a local node:http server on port 0 (no internet needed, same approach as Part 1 Step 12) for a good and a broken payload, then src/c12/users.test.ts tested with node:test + node:assert/strict via `node --test --test-reporter=spec "dist/**/*.test.js"` after tsc; real output of both run and tests. Security note: treat all external data (requests, files, LLM output) as untrusted.

mini_project.name: Type-safe Task Manager
mini_project.summary: A strict TypeScript 7 CLI at ~/projects/task-manager-ts that manages tasks stored in data/tasks.json. Domain types are derived from zod schemas, commands are a discriminated union parsed from process.argv into a Result, storage goes through a generic Repository<T extends Entity> (JsonFileRepository for real use, InMemoryRepository for tests), the JSON file is validated with zod on every read (clear error pointing to the bad field when the file is edited by hand), compiled with tsc 7.0.2 and tested with node:test. Portfolio-ready with README and a GitHub Actions workflow that runs npm ci, npm run typecheck and npm test.
features: Task model: id (format T-001, T-002 ...), title (1-100 chars), priority 'low'|'medium'|'high', status 'todo'|'doing'|'done', tags string[], optional dueDate (YYYY-MM-DD), createdAt (ISO string); TaskSchema in src/domain/task.ts with type Task = z.infer<typeof TaskSchema>

Commands (discriminated union on 'kind'): add "title" [--priority high] [--tag study] [--due 2026-10-25], list [--status todo|doing|done], start <id>, done <id>, remove <id>, stats, help; exhaustive switch with assertNever

Generic layer: interface Entity { readonly id: string }, interface Repository<T extends Entity> { findAll; findById; save; remove } all returning Promise, class JsonFileRepository<T> (uses #private fields, node:fs/promises, returns [] when the file does not exist, writes pretty JSON with 2 spaces) and class InMemoryRepository<T>
Service layer TaskService with methods using utility types: create(input: NewTask) where NewTask = Omit<Task,'id'|'createdAt'|'status'>, update(id, patch: TaskPatch), stats(): Record<Status, number>
CLI output formatted as aligned plain-text table with Thai messages, exit code 1 on errors (process.exitCode = 1), never throws raw stack traces at the user
Tests in src/**/*.test.ts with node:test using InMemoryRepository; npm test = tsc then node --test --test-reporter=spec "dist/**/*.test.js"

Sample data file data/tasks.json with T-001 'ติดตั้ง TypeScript 7' (high, done, tags [setup], createdAt 2026-10-19T09:00:00.000Z) and T-002 'อ่านบท Generics' (medium, doing, tags [study], dueDate 2026-10-25, createdAt 2026-10-19T09:05:00.000Z); data/bad.json for demonstrating validation errors
mini_project.stack: Node.js LTS 24.22.0 (also runs on 26.x) via nvm v0.40.8, ES modules ("type": "module"), typescript 7.0.2 (devDependency, --save-exact), @types/node 24.19.2 (devDependency), zod 4.6.7 (dependency), node:test + node:assert/strict (built in), Git 2.43.0 + GitHub Actions (actions/checkout and actions/setup-node with node-version: 24)

versions.typescript: 7.0.2 (Go-native compiler, command still tsc). Install locally: npm install -D --save-exact typescript@7.0.2 ; npx tsc -v prints 'Version 7.0.2'. The sandbox global tsc is 6.0.2 - NEVER use it; always use the project-local npx tsc from typescript@7.0.2. TypeScript 6.0.3 = last JS-based release, mention only when a tool needs the TS API (e.g. typescript-eslint 8.71.2 peer range typescript >=4.8.4 <6.1.0 -> ERESOLVE with TS 7).
versions.node: LTS via nvm v0.40.8 (nvm install --lts): 24.22.0 on 2026-10-19; 26.12.0 becomes Active LTS 2026-10-28. Code must run on 24 and 26. Type stripping (node file.ts) works unflagged on Node 22.18.0+ / 23.6.0+ and therefore on 24 and 26; erasable syntax only; Node does not type-check and does not read tsconfig.json. Sandbox is Node 22.22.0 - do not use APIs newer than Node 24.

notes: Practice project for Parts 2-3 is ~/projects/ts-lab (/home/somchai/projects/ts-lab), created in c01; source files go in src/, output in dist/. Part 1 used src/stepNN-*.ts names; Part 2 uses src/cNN-*.ts (e.g. src/c05-unions.ts) or src/cNN/ folders for multi-file concepts (c09, c12). Run pattern: npx tsc then node dist/cNN-name.js. Show file block, then run block, then out block.

package.json of ts-lab: {"name": "ts-lab", "version": "1.0.0", "type": "module", "scripts": {"build": "tsc", "typecheck": "tsc --noEmit", "dev": "node src/app.ts", "start": "node dist/app.js", "test": "tsc && node --test --test-reporter=spec \"dist/**/*.test.js\""}}

tsconfig (use EXACTLY this everywhere, including the mini project; it is accepted by TS 7.0.2): compilerOptions rootDir ./src, outDir ./dist, module nodenext, target es2024, types ["node"], sourceMap true, strict true, noUncheckedIndexedAccess true, exactOptionalPropertyTypes true, noImplicitReturns true, noImplicitOverride true, noFallthroughCasesInSwitch true, verbatimModuleSyntax true, isolatedModules true, erasableSyntaxOnly true, rewriteRelativeImportExtensions true, moduleDetection force, skipLibCheck true; include ["src"]. Comments in the JSON are in Thai.

Because of erasableSyntaxOnly: no enum, no namespace, no constructor parameter properties; relative imports are written with the .ts extension (import { x } from "./math.ts") and use `import type` for type-only imports.
Learner username is somchai; home /home/somchai; sample users somchai and somsri (roles 'admin' | 'member'); money in Thai baht formatted with toLocaleString('th-TH'); dates in 2026-10.

Always paste REAL tsc error output (format: src/file.ts:LINE:COL - error TSxxxx: message, followed by the code frame and 'Found N error(s) in ...'). Re-run with typescript@7.0.2 in the sandbox; do not reuse messages from TS 6 without checking.
Terminology: keep English terms in text (Type, Type Inference, Union, Narrowing, Generics, Compiler, Type Stripping, Schema, Runtime Validation), explanations in Thai, code comments in Thai.
Cross-links: JavaScript (prerequisite), Git/GitHub (push, Actions), Linux, SQL, Prompt Engineering (validating LLM output with zod).
No certifications exist for TypeScript itself ('ไม่มีใบรับรองหลัก'); Part 1 lists GH-900, GH-200, GH-300, AWS DVA-C02 (until 2026-11-30) / DVA-C03 (from 2026-12-01), CLF-C02 as related.
Network examples use a local node:http server on port 0 (127.0.0.1) so no internet or API key is needed.
